get_trainer_config: get the default MMF trainer config with optimizer, scheduler, and training parameters merged from defaults.yaml
get_config_with_defaults: merge a custom config dictionary with the default trainer config to produce a complete configuration
add_model: build a model, set it to train mode, move it to the trainer device, and attach it to the trainer
get_mmf_trainer: create an MMF trainer mock with a SimpleModel, optimizer, and loaded datasets for testing training loops
get_lightning_trainer: create a Lightning trainer mock with a SimpleLightningModel, meters, and optional preparation for testing
